SPECIAL ARTICLES
Sales of United States Savings Bonds by States During the Second War Loan

Information on sales during the Second War Loan of Series E savings bonds by States is now available and is shown below. This information is a supplement to the article on "Sales of United States Government Securities During the Second War Loan" which appeared in the "Treasury Bulletin" for May 1943, pages 2-6. That article compared the actual sales of securities during the drive with the goals; discussed in considerable detail the sales of securities by classes of investors and by issues; and compared the sales of securities during the First and Second War Loans.

As was pointed out in the article in the May 1943 "Treasury Bulletin", the Second War Loan formally opened on April 12 and closed on May 1. Sales of savings bonds were counted, however, from the first of April. Because of the lag involved in processing sales of savings bonds, sales reported through May 8 were also counted in the tabulations. Consequently, data on sales of savings bonds during the Second War Loan cover the period April 1 through May 8.
